title: 第22章 武道第23章 请罪
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: 滋滋滋。
火舌舔着油脂，被到来的身影撩动。
泼墨般硕大的影子将江霸等人笼罩了进去。
人群中，江浩心中带着憧憬，偷偷抬头瞥了一眼，逆光之下，他看不清来人面容，却只觉得其中一人的轮廓是如此的熟悉。
他用力眨眨眼，视线中的那道身影越来越清晰，但呼吸却是猛然停滞了下来。
“这些虚头巴脑的东西就别搞了，烦得慌，现在妖也斩了，还不速速备上好酒好菜。”
梁辉将大刀别在腰间，招呼沈长青一声，便大步从人群中穿过。
“长青老弟，咱们伏妖卫干的都是些把脑袋别在裤腰上的活计，指不定哪天就一命呜呼了，现在事也干完了，咱们该享受的时候就得享受。”
他好似没睡够，又打了个哈欠，松松裤腰，随后便是径直走向了城楼，那里早有江家堡精心准备的宴席。
长青？
江家堡众人被这两个字眼触动，像是想到了什么，他们猛然抬起了头，眼睛逐渐瞪得浑圆，脸上也被极度的震惊与错愕填满。
他们看到了什么，原来方才出手斩妖的，竟然是昔日那个从江家堡中走出去的“孤儿”！
“沈……沈长青？”
尤其是江霸，神情惊愕无比，他几乎以为自己眼花了，“刚才，是你救了我？”
沈长青将众人的反应尽收眼底，尤其是江浩父子那副见了鬼一般的神情，但他只是扫视了他们一眼，眼神中，没有喜悦，亦没有高高在上，有的只是如水一般的沉静。
他没有回答江霸的问题，只是道：“江霸，你江家堡收留我，让我能在这外城区有一个安身之地，如今，我救了江家堡也算是偿还了你们的恩情。”
他说罢，便不再停留，直接向人群后方走去。
在那里，是一脸呆滞的江良与江伯。
“长，长青大哥，真的是你？”江良眼睛大睁，语气中竟是不可置信。
“是我。”
沈长青微笑点头，伸手在掌中凭空御出一朵灵火。
见到灵火，江良眼中的震惊逐渐被巨大的狂喜覆盖，他怎么也没想到，方才那个大显神威的大人物，竟真的是沈长青！
江伯浑浊的眼中也闪过一丝欣慰与自豪的光芒，喃喃道：“好，好孩子，我就知道你能成……”
沈长青收了灵火，看着江伯的双腿，道：“江伯，小良，我们先回去吧。”
江伯与小良自是没意见，很快，三人有说有笑的离开了此地。
周围江家堡众人看着江伯与江良，眼中一时竟有些羡慕与嫉妒了起来。
“爹，爹，他……是沈长青？”
看着那道离去的背影，江浩显得有些失魂落魄，像是还没缓过神来。
江霸神情渐渐从惊愕中醒来，他复杂无比的吐了一口气，“是他，没想到他不仅成了，而且还加入了镇妖司。”
回想到先前自己被救下的场景，以及那日在江伯家对对方说的话，他就有些无地自容。
江浩张着口说不出话来。
曾经那个卑微如尘的小子，如今摇身一变，却成了他们口中的大人物，这转变，着实令他们难以在短时间内适应过来。
赵河山注意到了江家堡众人怪异的神情，他不禁疑惑：“老江，你们这是？”
content_en:
Sizzle.
The tongue of fire licked the grease, and was stirred by the approaching figure.
A shadow as big as splashing ink enveloped Jiang Ba and the others.
In the crowd, Jiang Hao secretly glanced up with longing in his heart. Under the backlight, he couldn't see clearly the face of the person coming, but he only felt that the outline of one of them was so familiar.
He blinked hard, and the figure in his sight became clearer and clearer, but his breathing suddenly stopped.
"Stop doing these silly things. I'm so annoyed. Now that the demon has been killed, why don't we prepare some good wine and good food as soon as possible."
Liang Hui put the big knife on his waist, greeted Shen Changqing, and strode through the crowd.
"Brother Changqing, all we Demon Subduing Guards do is work with our heads stuck on our waistbands. We might end up dying one day. Now that we have finished our work, we have to enjoy it when we should."
As if he hadn't slept enough, he yawned again, loosened his trousers, and then walked straight to the tower, where there was a banquet carefully prepared by Jiang Jiabao.
Evergreen?
Everyone in Jiangjiabao was touched by these two words, as if they thought of something. They suddenly raised their heads, their eyes gradually widened, and their faces were filled with extreme shock and astonishment.
What did they see? It turned out that the one who had just taken action to slay the demon was actually the "orphan" who walked out of Jiangjiabao in the past!
"Shen...Shen Changqing?"
Jiang Ba, in particular, looked so shocked that he almost thought he was dazzled, "Did you save me just now?"
Shen Changqing had a panoramic view of everyone's reactions, especially the expressions of Jiang Hao and his son who looked like they had seen ghosts. However, he just glanced at them. There was no joy or condescension in his eyes, but a calmness like water.
He did not answer Jiang Ba's question, but just said: "Jiang Ba, Jiangjiabao took me in and allowed me to have a place to live in the outer city. Now, I have repaid your kindness by saving Jiangjiabao."
After he said that, he stopped staying and walked directly to the back of the crowd.
There were Jiang Liang and Jiang Bo with dull faces.
"Chang, Brother Changqing, is it really you?" Jiang Liang's eyes widened, and his tone was unbelievable.
"It's me."
Shen Changqing smiled and nodded, stretched out his hand and pulled out a spiritual fire out of thin air.
Seeing the spirit fire, the shock in Jiang Liang's eyes was gradually covered by huge ecstasy. He never expected that the big man showing off his power just now was actually Shen Changqing!
A glimmer of relief and pride flashed through Uncle Jiang's cloudy eyes, and he murmured: "Okay, good boy, I knew you could become..."
Shen Changqing withdrew the spiritual fire, looked at Uncle Jiang's legs, and said: "Uncle Jiang, Xiaoliang, let's go back first."
"Okay."
Jiang Bo and Xiao Liang had no objection, and soon the three of them left the place talking and laughing.
Everyone in Jiangjiabao looked at Jiang Bo and Jiang Liang, and for a moment there was some envy and jealousy in their eyes.
"Dad, dad, he...is Shen Changqing?"
Looking at the departing figure, Jiang Hao seemed a little lost, as if he hadn't recovered yet.
Jiang Ba gradually woke up from the shock, and he let out a complicated breath, "It's him. I didn't expect that not only did he become the leader, but he also joined the Demon Suppression Division."
Recalling the scene where he was rescued and what he said to Uncle Jiang at his house that day, he felt a little ashamed.
Jiang Hao opened his mouth and was speechless.
The once humble boy has now transformed into a big shot in their mouths. This change is really difficult for them to adapt to in a short period of time.
Zhao Heshan noticed the strange expressions of everyone in Jiangjiabao, and he couldn't help but wonder: "Lao Jiang, what are you doing?"
